text:
Typical application development process

Because the platform is unidentified, this is a generic provisional workflow rather than a confirmed platform-specific process. No execution is being started.

Diagram
flowchart TD
  A[1. Discover
You define the problem, users, goals, and constraints
Evidence: problem statement and success criteria]
  B[2. Specify
You describe requirements, workflows, data, and acceptance criteria
Evidence: backlog, requirements, and acceptance tests]
  C[3. Design
You review architecture, interfaces, security, and deployment choices
Evidence: solution design, diagrams, and decisions]
  D[4. Build and configure
You create application logic, user interfaces, integrations, and configuration
Evidence: source files, configuration, dependencies, and change history]
  E[5. Validate
You run reviews and functional, security, and performance tests
Evidence: review records, test results, defects, and fixes]
  F[6. Package and approve
You select a tested version and approve it for release
Evidence: versioned artifact, release notes, and approval record]
  G[7. Deploy
You provide environment settings and initiate the approved deployment
Evidence: deployment record, configuration, status, and endpoint]
  H[8. Operate and improve
You monitor usage, health, incidents, and feedback
Evidence: logs, metrics, alerts, feedback, and improvement backlog]
  A --> B --> C --> D --> E --> F --> G --> H
  H --> A
limitations: The specific platform and its actual workflow are not identified, so platform-specific stages, controls, and evidence cannot be confirmed.
